cites.quote: An appointment cancelled or marked No-show within the one day is no longer `Scheduled` and is not marked Stale.
- options: Yes, confirm | No-show still becomes Stale

findings.text: REQ-6 is compound: it covers two behaviours (Cancelled is not Stale; No-show is not Stale). A-05's options also treated them separately. REQ-4 and REQ-5 split the analogous Completed and rescheduled cases.
